topic: A forged sandbox setting is taken at restart and never marks a digest (security audit medium)
detail: D-61 makes the setting quiet: it shows in orch status and the app, not in start digests. A process running as the user (not a sandboxed shell: orch.db is outside every space's writable folders, and the guard refuses tool calls naming it) can write a matching spaces_enforcement row and log entry for 'off' while orchd is stopped; the next start takes it with no problem, as it would a switch, but no digest says so. An inconsistent edit now makes the setting on and is reported. Options: (a) name the setting in the next digest once after each change or restart where it is off; (b) a keyed MAC over the row and log, with the key outside orch.db; (c) accept as D-61 decided. Blocks SP-046 (DOD-6) until decided.
resolution: Settled by the user on 2026-11-14 as D-68; implemented by the SP-046 follow-up lane.
